title: Hearth of the Veil
shortDescription: Silver curtains keep half the room in honest shadow.
longDescription:
The Hearth of the Veil is quieter than its neighbours. Pale curtains take the light and give it back in pieces, like moonlight through thin ice. A tall dark mirror stands where a first-year will want to look too long. The floor is worn in a path that does not go straight. The air smells of cold stone, silver polish, and a little crushed lavender.
Mentor Mist does not fill the silence. She uses it.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Mist
fixtures.lookDescription: A pale ermine in a silver-grey cloak, one eye kept in shadow. Try talk mist.
fixtures.examineDescription: Mist's fur is almost white. The cloak drinks sound. She watches the end of a sentence, not the start of it.
fixtures.dialogue: "Look around this hearth. The curtains keep honest shadow. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room. Come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves in your Field Primer."

welcome.text: "Lavender. Cold stone. A mirror that is only a mirror until you waste time in it. Look around this hearth. Then attack the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy, unless you are still learning the spark. Come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book. I pen the first three leaves after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the page offers three choices. Type 1, 2, or 3. Quiet work is still work. Do not skip the dummy because the room is dim."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here in the quiet. The silence is not empty. Neither am I."

lessons-done.text: "The three starter leaves are inked. Cast shade at the hearth dummy for the second lesson. After that, the Primer will offer three leaves. Type 1, 2, or 3."

third-lesson.text: "Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall. If he is still sending you down the Clock Tower stair, finish that first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "College lessons in this hearth are complete. Keep the Primer. Each new lesson opens three leaves. I still sign the page even when I am not at your shoulder. Eat something warm before you take a cold road."

fixtures.name: Dark Mirror
fixtures.examineDescription: The glass does not flatter. It shows the room behind you more clearly than the face in front. A slate says: 'Name what moved.'
